rdf:Description.rdfs:label: controls project finances
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of controlling the financial aspects of the research project, including authorizing expenditure, creating and managing budgets, and submitting financial reports to the funding agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doctoral student
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person registerd for a Ph.D. degree at a university.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: faculty member
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an academic employed to undertake research and teaching within a university department, school or institute.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: formulates research questions
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of formulating the questions to be answered and the hypotheses to be tested by the research to be undertaken.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: programme manager
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person who is in charge of a programme of related activities or projects, for example on behalf of a funding agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data user
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a user or re-user of existing data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: provides patients
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of providing access to medical or veterinary patients, to make possible the research.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: with contribution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between an agent's contribution situation and a definition of the contribution made by this agent.
rdf:Description.skos:note: This is specified as an instance of the class `scoro:Contribution` or of one of its sub-classes.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: creates software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of creating computer software, including software for experimental control, analytical tools, mathematical model and computational simulations for use in the research, or of creating an IT service (e.g. a bioinformatics database or Web service) of use to others.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: builds and/or maintains instruments
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of building instruments, equipment or scientific apparatus and/or maintaining the same in a workable condition for use in experiments.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: photographer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a photographer of, or for, some entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: designs experiments
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of experimental design and planning.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: consortium author
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The authorship role of an organisation or consortium that has contributed collectively to the work described in the publication and is named in the list of authors, e.g. 'Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium' or 'Malaria Genomic Epidemiology Network'.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: CTO
chief technology officer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person who is the chief technology officer of an organization, responsible for directing and managing technical developments for that organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patent holder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent who holds a patent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has ORCID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between an individual and their Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID), an alphanumeric identifier for individual scholars described at http://about.orcid.org/.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: processs data
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of processing, cleaning, assembling, condensing or refining the data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has personal identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A unique and unambiguous identifier for an individual person within a given context.
rdf:Description.skos:note: This is specified by the object property `scoro:usesPersonalIdentifierScheme` and an individual member of the class `scoro:PersonalIdentifierScheme`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: undertakes modelling
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of design, implementation and analysis of mathematical models or computer simulations.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publishes data
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of publishing in a public database or data repository data arising from the research.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Note that this activity is distinct from that of publishing a journal article containing a selection of these data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contributed major effort
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contributor provided a major effort towards achieving this contribution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: leads investigation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of providing intellectual leadership and direction for the research.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Note that an individual other than the principal investigator and the co-investigators may make considerable leadership contributions to a research investigation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Scholarly Contributions and Roles Ontology (SCoRO)
rdf:Description.dc:creator: David Shotton (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5506-523X)
Silvio Peroni (https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0530-4305)
rdf:Description.dc:title: The Scholarly Contributions and Roles Ontology (SCoRO)
rdf:Description.dcterms:bibliographicCitation: Shotton, D., & Peroni, S. (2017). SCoRO, the scholarly contributions and roles ontology. http://purl.org/spar/scoro.
rdf:Description.vann:changes: * **v1.10.1**: added new documentation, including annotation properties (e.g., `bibo:doi`, `schema:codeRepository`, etc.), term properties (e.g., `vann:example`, `vs:term_status`, etc.), exemplary competency questions with their respective SPARQL queries, and a Grafoo diagram.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: prepares supplementary information
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of preparing the supplementary information files submitted with the manuscript.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: accountant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person whose job is to manage financial accounts, for example the accounts of an organization, or of a particular funded project or activity of that organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: owner
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent who is the owner of something with actual or potential financial value, for example a building, a piece of equipment, the copyright of a document, or the intellectual property rights relating to an idea or discovery.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: claimant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person making a financial claim, for example for refund of travel expenses from a project grant.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: organizer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent who organizes something, such as a conference, a private meeting or a public event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: maintains organisms or cell cultures
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of maintaining multicellular organisms (plants, animals or fungi) or cell cultures used as experimental subjects, and of breeding these where appropriate.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Note that there may be occasions when it is inappropriate to acknowledge such contributions, for fear of personal reprisals on the individuals involved from animal rights activists.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vice-chancellor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by the chief executive officer of a university, responsible for directing and managing its business and academic activities.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: auditor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person who conducts a formal audit of financial accounts.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: time indexed situation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A situation that is explicitly indexed at some time for at least one entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: experimental contribution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The type or nature of a practical or experimental contribution made to the research.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Individual members of this class are used to specify particular contributions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supervisor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who guides and oversees the research activities of a team member, or who formally supervises a student during that student's research project undertaken as part of a degree course at a university.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contractor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent who enters into a contract to undertake specified work or to supply specified services in return for payment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: project manager
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being project manager for a project such as a research project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manager
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person responsible for managing the day-to-day activities of an activity, enterprise or organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: educational role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that an agent might hold with respect to an educational organization or activity.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Individual members of this class are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: performs experiments
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of performing experiments.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: maintains IT infrastructure
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of maintaining the IT infrastructure required for the research.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: co-applicant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a co-applicant on the grant application to obtain funding to fund an endeavour such as a research project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaser
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent of making purchases of goods or services, the cost of which is typically charged to a particular academic budget, for example a project manager placing an order to purchase equipment funded from a research grant.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: financial role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that an agent might hold with respect to academic and project finance.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Individual members of this class are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is equal to role in time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between two roles in time as being equal, and is particularly useful for specifying that two principal authorship roles are equal.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that an agent might hold with respect to data.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Individual members of this class are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contributed all the effort
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contributor was the only person who provided effort in achieving this contribution, which was entirely due to this contributor.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: provides software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of providing software to facilitate the research, while not actively participating in the work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is related to contribution situation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between an entity and the contribution situation for which that entity provides the context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data curator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a data curator, responsible reviewing, enhancing, cleaning, or standardizing data and their associated metadata, for example those arising from the research project, and for their long-term preservation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: provides advice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of providing advice to facilitate the research, while not actively participating in the work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contribution effort
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The effort expended in making a contribution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: within context
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The specific context within which the fact of the entity having the value is relevant.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: provides technical support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of providing technical support that facilitates research.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: investigation role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that an agent might hold with respect to an investigation.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Individual members of this class are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: consultant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a consultant who is providing expertise or services.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: repository manager
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a manager of a repository where entities are given secure long-term storage, typically digital repository for information objects, for example a data repository.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: director
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person who is in charge of an organization or activity, for example a research institute or a dramatic performance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has contribution context
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between a contribution situation and an entity representing the context for that situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contact person
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who serves as the primary contact and information provider for third parties wishing to find out more about an organization or an activity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: intellectual contribution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The type or nature of an intellectual contribution made to the research described in a journal article.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Individual members of this class are used to specify particular contributions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service engineer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person who services, maintains and repairs equipment, facilities or technical infrastructure.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: master student
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person registerd for a master degree at a university.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: computational agent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A computer system or software program whose action has an effect on external events, for example a laboratory robot that undertakes your experiments, or the financial control system that controls an institution's payrole, or that, following programmed business rules, prevents the principal investigator from placing an order for research equipment because there is insufficient money left in the project budget.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: non-academic staff member
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person employed within a university department, school or institute who is not a member of the academic faculty.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is equal to contribution situation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between two contribution situations that are equals for particular aspects (i.e. for type of contribution, contribution effort and context).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: college head
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a senior academic who heads a college and acts as its CEO. Among the many alternative titles give to this role, the most common are President or Master of the college.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: project student
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a project student, namely someone engaged in an undergraduate research project as part of studying for an undergraduate degree at a university, whose research will be presented in an undergraduate research project report in part fulfilment of the requirements of that degree.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: participant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent who takes part in something, for example a conference, a private meeting or a public event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: successor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship held by an entity that succeeds another, for example a new electron microscope that replaces an out-dated one, a research project that follows on from a preceding project, or a faculty member who succeeds a colleague as head of department.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: authorship role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that a person might hold as an author of a publication or the creator of a work.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Individual members of this class are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data manager
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a data manager, responsible for day-to-day management, maintenance and back-up of data, for example those arising from the research project or held in a repository.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent of providing goods or services in exchange for payment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: project member
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a member of a project such as a research project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: makes contribution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between an agent and a contribution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: departmental administrator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person who is the administrator of a department within a larger organization, for example of a university academic department.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: with contribution effort
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between an agent's contribution with respect to a particular entity and the amount of effort exerted by this agent in making that contribution, defined by individuals of the class scoro:ContributionEffort.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: organizational contribution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The type or nature of an organizational or administrative contribution.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Individual members of this class are used to specify particular contributions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: provides existing data
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of providing pre-existing data for re-use in the research.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: head of department
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person who is the chief executive officer of a department within a larger organization, for example a senior academic who is head of a university academic department.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: researcher
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a researcher involved in a research investigation, for example by conducting experiments, collecting and analyzing data, or undertaking formal study.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: corresponding author
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role an author has of being the corresponding author of the document, with whom editors and readers should correspond concerning it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: provided service
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of providing a research service, for example a DNA sequencing service or a custom peptide synthesis service.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: affiliate
rdf:Description.skos:note: The affiliation of a person to an organization or institution can be specified by using the property `pro:relatesToEntity`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role an agent has of being affiliated to some organization or institution in a context of some entity or activity, for example a document, a project or an internship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent of providing funds, for example for a research project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: host institution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a institution of hosting some initiative, people, or event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: stakeholder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent with an interest or concern in something, for example the creation of a new university.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: scholar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an academic who undertakes scholarly activities, including research investigations. This role is particularly used to describe endeavours in the arts and humanites that are frequently undertaken without financial support from a particular funded project dedicated to these scholarly activities.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sponsor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent that provides funds or support for a person, project or activity, often in return for access to the exploitable commercial potential associated with that person’s work, or that project or activity’s output, for example through equity sharing or publicity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conceives project
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of conceiving the research project in the first place.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Note that an individual other than the lead applicant and the co-applicants on a grant application may make considerable contributions to conceiving a research project, but may be prevented from being a formal applicant by reason of affiliation or status (e.g. as a non-academic partner, or a research student).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: principal investigator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being the principal investigator for a research investigation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has personal identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A unique and unambiguous identifier for an individual person within a given context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: employer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent that employs one or more people to undertake work on that agent's behalf.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration agency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an agent officially appointed by a Registration Authority that acts to register things. For example, CrossRef is a registration agency for DOIs relating to documents, while DataCite is a registration agency for DOIs relating to datasets, both acting for the Registration Authority for DOIs, namely the International DOI Foundation (IDF).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rights holder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent who holds, owns and manages the legal rights to a project or activity and its products and outcomes, for example the exploitation, licensing and intellectual property rights.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: organizational role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that an agent might hold with respect to an organization and its administration, particularly within an academic context.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Individual members of this class are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: authorship contribution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The type or nature of a contribution made with respect to the authorship of a publication such as a journal article.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Individual members of this class are used to specify particular contributions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: postgraduate student
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person registerd for a graduate (masters or doctoral) degree at a university.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: agent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any kind of agents, such as a person, a group, an organization or a software agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: postdoctoral researcher
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a post-doctoral researcher involved in a research investigation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data creator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a creator, originator, gatherer or collector of new data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: provides tools, equipment or facilities
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of providing tools, equipment or facilities for the research, while not actively participating in the work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: for entity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a time-indexed situation and an entity involved in it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: research assistant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a research assistant involved in a research investigation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secures funding
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of securing funding for the research project.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Note that an individual other than the lead applicant and the co-applicants on a grant application may make contributions to securing funding for a research project, for example by assisting in writing the grant application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: provides administrative support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of providing administrative support for the research project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data publisher
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an agent who publishes data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: value in time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A particular kind of time-indexed situation that represents a hub linking the entity having a particular value, the value itself and the temporal and contextual extents from which the entity-value relationship depends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sub-contractor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent who enters into a contract to take over part of another contractor's obligation to undertake specified work or supply specified services in return for payment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: illustrator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being an illustrator of, or for, some entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: principal author
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role an author has of being the principal or primary author of the document, who has contributed most to the work described.
rdf:Description.skos:note: In some communities, but not all, the principal author is named first in the author list. Two or more authors can have the role of principal author if they contributed equally to the work. This role should not be employed in communities in which no primacy of authorship is asserted, but where all authors are deemed to have made an equal contribution to the work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: employee
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person employed for wages or a salary by an organization, to undertake work for that organization.
author

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: prepares illustrations
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of selecting the data and preparing the figures and tables presenting these data for inclusion in the publication.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: develops methodology
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of developing experimental methodology that enables research.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: revises manuscript
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of critically reviewing and revising drafts of the manuscript of the research paper.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: computer programmer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being someone who develops computer software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: access provider
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an agent who provides access to a resource, for example an online data repository.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity and a value in time situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: member
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent of belonging to a group or organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: collects data
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of making experimental observations and collecting data, for example using a telescope, a microscope or an analytical instrument.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyses data
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of data analysis. This might include statistical analysis, bioinformatics analysis, or image analysis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registrar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent responsible for maintaining official records, for example the records of student enrollment and academic standing held by a college or university, or the records of securities owned by a financial institution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: web-master
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person responsible for maintaining a web site and its content.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: project role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that an agent might hold with respect to a project.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Individual members of this class are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: maintains research facility
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of managing and operating a research facility, for example a confocal microscopy facility.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: writes manuscript draft
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of writing the initial draft of the manuscript of the research paper.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: spokesperson
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person who makes statements on behalf of another individual, a group, a project or an institution

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: college fellow
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an academic as a senior member of a college.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is contribution in
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a specific contribution and the contribution situation of an agent making that contribution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: approves final manuscript
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of approving the final version of the manuscript, prior to submission for publication.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: technician
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a technician, providing technical assistance in some endeavour such as a research investigation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: percentage full-time equivalent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The proportion of a person's full time activity that is dedicated to a particular role (e.g. for part-time employment, 50% FTE).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration authority
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an agent with responsibility for registering and maintaining international standards, internet domain names, patents, controlled vocabularies and other similar entities required for reliable international cooperatative activities. For example, the International DOI Foundation (IDF) is the Registration Authority for DOIs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: curator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an agent that documents, cares for and manages collections of objects (for example in a museum) or of data (as in a data repository or database).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contributed minor effort
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contributor provided a minor effort towards achieving this contribution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: CEO
chief executive officer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person who is the chief executive officer of an organization, responsible for directing and managing the business of that organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is made by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between a contribution situation that an agent makes, and that agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: creates novel reagents
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of creating novel physical or chemical compounds, or molecular biology constructs, either for use in the research, or as a research output of use to others.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manages project
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of project management.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Note that an individual other than the person holding the formal role of project manager may make considerable contributions to the management of a research project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: person
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A person.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: with job title
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A job title that characterizes an agent's role in time.
rdf:Description.skos:note: This data property complements the definition of that role in time specified by `scoro:Role`. For example, for the `scoro:OrganizationRole` 'Head of Department', the specific Job Title might be 'Linacre Professor of Zoology' or 'Regius Professor of Moral Philosophy'.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lead applicant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being the lead applicant on the grant application to obtain funding to fund an endeavour such as a research project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ensures regulatory compliance
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of ensuring regulatory compliance for the research undertaken, for example in obtaining informed consent from patients, approval from research ethics or radiation safety committees, or a license for animal experimentation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: co-investigator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a co-investigator for a research investigation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inventor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being the inventor or some entity (for example, a computer algorithm, or an experimental procedure).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contribution situation
rdf:Description.skos:note:
A contribution situation describes always: - a particular contribution C - a particular agent A making contribution C - a particular time interval T in which A makes C (optional) - a particular contribution effort E - one or more entities (e.g. an investigation or data) that defines a context for C contributed by A. (At least one contextual entity should be specified for a particular contribution).
The type or nature of the contribution is defined by the object of the object property `scoro:withContribution`, which is an individual in the class `scoro:Contribution` or one of its sub-classes. The entity to which the contribution relates is specified using the object property `scoro:relatesToEntity` or one of its sub-properties, and the effort expended in making that contribution is specified using the object property `scoro:withContributionEffort`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The situation an agent has of making a contribution to realizing a goal or completing a task relating to a scholarly activity or entity such as journal article.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding recipient
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent who is the official recipient of funding, for example the university of which a funded research project leader is a member.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: agent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An agent that acts on behalf of another agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: creates novel organisms or cells
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of creating novel organisms (e.g. mouse mutants) or cells (e.g. tranformed cell lines), either for use in the research, or as a research output of use to others.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: financial controller
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent of controlling the finances, for example the finances of an organization, a building project or a research project. This role extends to the control of or the authorisation of expenditure from a budget, and may be undertaken by a computational agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: partner
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a person who is a partner with one or more other people in an organization, project, endeavour, activity or sphere of common interest.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: undergraduate student
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person registerd for an undergraduate degree at a university.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obtains and/or prepared specimens
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of obtaining and/or preparing specimens in a manner requiring research expertise or skill, for example collecting and preparing fossils, or preparing electron microscope specimens for examination.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: administrator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent responsible for the day-to-day management and running of an organization or activity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: workpackage leader
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person or institution has of being leader for a workpackage or sub-project within a project such as a research project, with responsibility for ensuring that the proposed work is undertaken and documented, the generated data are properly curated and archived, and the results are published and reported to the funding agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contribution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The type or nature of a contribution made by an agent. Individual members of this class or its sub-classes are used to specify particular contributions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: embargo controller
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of the person who has responsibility for setting and lifting embargos that restrict access to a dataset (or a document) for a specified period of time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: research student
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a research student, namely someone engaged in research as part of studying for a higher degree at a university or research institute, whose research will be presented in a thesis in part fulfilment of the requirements of that degree.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: provides reagents, specimens or materials
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of providing reagents, specimens or materials, including living organisms and cells, for example those not readily obtainable from commercial sources, to make possible the research.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: article guarantor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who takes responsibility for the integrity of the work as a whole, from the inception of the research investigation to the published research article.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: collaborator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person, typically from another research group or institution, who collaborates with the team undertaking a research investigation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: role in time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A particular situation that describe a role an agent may have, that can be restricted to a particular time interval.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: interprets results
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of interpretation of experimental results.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: possessor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent as possessor or owner of some entity such as an address or a telephone number.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: chief scientist
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A senior scientist who takes a leadership role in an organization or group.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has time indexed setting
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity and a time-indexed situation it is involved in.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: with value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between the value in time situation and the actual value held by the entity partaking in that situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Supervises, mentors or trains colleagues
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The contribution of supervising, mentoring, instructing or training colleagues, particularly junior research assistants and research students, in aspects of the research or its methodologies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: senior author
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role an author has of being the senior author of the document.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has orcid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An individual's Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID), an alphanumeric identifier for individual scholars described at http://about.orcid.org/.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role an agent may have. Individual members of this class or its sub-classes are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: project leader
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person or an institution has of being project leader for a resource or a project such as a research project.
